chunks: Al-Hasan ibn Mahbub narrated from Safwan ibn Yahya al-Jammal that he heard Abu Abdullah عليه السلام say:
Whoever finds lost property and does not announce it, then it is later found in his possession, it belongs to its owner, and an equivalent of it is due from the wealth of the one who concealed it.

key_terms.ضَالَّةً: lost property or an item that has gone missing from its owner
key_terms.كَتَمَهَا: concealed it and did not disclose it
key_terms.يُعَرِّفْهَا: to announce it publicly so that its owner may be identified

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling on someone who finds lost property and hides it instead of announcing it?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling regarding lost property: one who finds it must publicize it rather than conceal it. If he hides it and it is later discovered with him, the item remains the right of its owner, and he is also liable for an equivalent amount as a penalty for concealment.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.4052 - Al-Hasan ibn Mahbub narrated from Safwan ibn Yahya al-Jammal that he heard Abu Abdullah (as) say:

"Whoever finds lost property and does not announce it, then it is later found in his possession, it must be returned to its owner, and he must also pay an equivalent amount from his own wealth for having concealed it."
